profiles.name: Abdul Ghani Ahmad
profiles.description: Abdul Ghani Ahmad represents Jerlun, Kedah, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

milestones.title: Continue annual Ramadan and Aidilfitri support for orphans in Jerlun
milestones.description: Abdul Ghani committed his local organisation to continue the annual support programme.
milestones.progress_note: The report describes 31 children attending the preceding day’s programme. That event does not verify delivery of every later annual round. Current overall outcome and completion remain unknown.

milestones.title: Support Budget 2027 under the CSA
milestones.description: The MP was a named agreement signatory.
milestones.progress_note: Signing is documented; subsequent budget votes were not verified. Outcome and completion remain unknown.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date.
